date_from.description: Override the start of the query window (e.g. '-7d'). Rejected for HogQLQuery metrics, whose window is fixed in SQL.

date_to.description: Override the end of the query window.

interval.description:
Override the bucket interval. Rejected for HogQLQuery metrics.

* `second` - second
* `minute` - minute
* `hour` - hour
* `day` - day
* `week` - week
* `month` - month
* `quarter` - quarter
* `year` - year

offset.description: Rows to skip, to read the page after a run that returned has_more. Pass next_offset from that run. Only HogQLQuery metrics accept it. Runs made with a personal or project API key are rejected.

query_id.description: Client-supplied id to correlate or cancel the run.

refresh.description:
Cache/execution behavior, same semantics as /query/. Omit to serve a fresh cache hit and calculate blocking when stale.

* `blocking` - blocking
* `async` - async
* `lazy_async` - lazy_async
* `force_blocking` - force_blocking
* `force_async` - force_async
* `force_cache` - force_cache
